Tom Olsen
Tom Olsen began working for Farmers Coop Society in 2008. Tom is currently Executive Director of Grain & Agronomy Operations and Procurement. Tom graduated from IWCC in 1995. Tom’s favorite part of his day is working with suppliers to get the best deal possible on crop inputs along with working with the operations teams to make sure they are successfully serving our patrons.
Certifications: IDALS Commercial Pesticide Licences, HazMat Technision Training.
Jake Korzeniewski
Jake Korzeniewski began working for Farmers Coop Society in 2023. He is currently the Senior Director of Grain Operations. He graduated from South Dakota State University in 2015. Jake's favorite part of his day is overcoming obstacles that arise and providing the best experience for our customers.
Steve Winter
Steve Winter began working for Farmers Coop Society in 2017. He is currently Location Manager in Little Rock and the Agronomy Central Dispatch Manger. He graduated from Northwest Iowa Community College in 2017 with an AAS degree in Agriculture and a Diploma in Agricultural Business Management. Steve’s favorite part of his day is coming to work and finding ways to solve problems.
Certifications: Application I &II, CDL with Hazmat & Tanker Endorsements, Fire Fighter I &II, HazWoper
Joe Hofmeyer
Joe Hofmeyer began working for Farmers Coop Society in 2024. He is currently a Grain Marketing Specialist based out of Sioux Center. He graduated from Bethel University in 2010. Joe's favorite part of his day is getting the opportunity to be in relationship with our producer customers and working with them to make their operation and the Coop successful.
Certifications: Certified Professional in Supply Chain Management (CPSM)
Bill Kodad
Bill Kodad began working for Farmers Coop Society in 2024. He is currently a Grain Marketing Specialist. He graduated from the University of Nebraska-Omaha in 1990. Bill’s favorite part of his day is getting to know each grower and evaluating their unique needs in grain marketing.
